name: create_danmaku_report
description: Build a creator-facing report with full danmaku analysis; no model calls occur inside this tool. For classification returned by query_danmaku, submit current offset and topics_json: an array of {topic_key:T1..T6,title,observation,recommendation,sample_ids,optional video_context,optional video_at_ms}. Assign EVERY current batch ID exactly once; sample_ids means all members, not examples. Reuse topic_key across batches and update its prose using prior conclusions plus current feedback. Include video_evidence_id when available. Server saves the draft, computes exact counts and returns the next full batch. The LAST batch automatically renders and delivers the HTML report; earlier batches do not finish the run. A report cannot be produced with unread or unclassified text. For zero messages, pass evidence_id only. Legacy data without audience uses sections_json with up to 6 observations and 1-4 legacy sample IDs each.
